title.en-US: Useful Range of an Acid Buffer

prompt.zh-CN: 弱酸 HA 与其共轭碱 A- 组成的缓冲液，缓冲能力通常在什么条件附近最好？
prompt.en-US: For a buffer made of weak acid HA and conjugate base A-, when is buffering usually best?

text.zh-CN: pH 远大于 pKa 5 个单位
text.en-US: pH is more than 5 units above pKa
pH is approximately equal to pKa
The solution contains no A-

text.zh-CN: 溶液被稀释到没有溶质
text.en-US: The solution is diluted until no solute remains

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。亨德森-哈塞尔巴尔赫关系显示，当酸和共轭碱浓度接近时 pH≈pKa。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. Henderson-Hasselbalch shows pH≈pKa when acid and conjugate base concentrations are similar.

prompt.zh-CN: 典型 SN1 反应的速率决定步骤通常依赖哪些浓度？
prompt.en-US: The rate-determining step of a typical SN1 reaction usually depends on which concentrations?

text.en-US: Both substrate and nucleophile
Only the substrate concentration
Only the solvent concentration
Only product concentration

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。SN1 速率决定步骤是底物离解形成碳正离子，通常表现为一级动力学。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. The rate-determining step is substrate ionization to form a carbocation, usually first-order kinetics.

prompt.zh-CN: 可逆放热反应达到平衡后升高温度，平衡通常向哪一侧移动？
prompt.en-US: For a reversible exothermic reaction at equilibrium, raising temperature usually shifts equilibrium toward which side?

text.en-US: The exothermic forward direction
The endothermic reverse direction
It changes no concentrations

text.zh-CN: 一定完全转化为生成物
text.en-US: It fully converts to products

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。升温相当于加入热量，平衡会偏向吸热方向以抵消变化。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. Raising temperature adds heat, so equilibrium shifts toward the endothermic direction.

prompt.zh-CN: 同周期中，氮的第一电离能通常高于氧，主要原因是什么？
prompt.en-US: Across a period, nitrogen's first ionization energy is usually higher than oxygen's. Why?

text.zh-CN: 氮的有效核电荷明显低于氧
text.en-US: Nitrogen has much lower effective nuclear charge than oxygen

text.zh-CN: 氮的 2p 半充满结构较稳定，氧有成对电子排斥
text.en-US: Nitrogen's half-filled 2p subshell is relatively stable, while oxygen has paired-electron repulsion

text.zh-CN: 氧的 2p 轨道完全充满
text.en-US: Oxygen's 2p orbitals are completely filled

text.zh-CN: 氮的第一电离移除的是 2s 电子
text.en-US: Nitrogen's first ionization removes a 2s electron

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。这是周期趋势中常见的电子排布例外。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. This is a common electron-configuration exception to the periodic trend.

prompt.zh-CN: 在 1H NMR 中，靠近强吸电子基团的氢核通常会怎样？
prompt.en-US: In 1H NMR, protons near strongly electron-withdrawing groups usually do what?

text.en-US: Become more shielded, with smaller chemical shift
Become deshielded, with larger chemical shift

text.zh-CN: 只改变积分面积，不改变位移
text.en-US: Only the integration area changes, not the shift

text.zh-CN: 全部移动到 TMS 的 0 ppm 附近
text.en-US: They all move near the TMS signal at 0 ppm

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是 B。吸电子环境会降低局部电子屏蔽，使质子信号下场移动。
reveal.en-US: The answer is B. Electron-withdrawing environments reduce shielding and shift proton signals downfield.
